bare_mention_means: Maison Alhambra Woody Oud, the budget Tom Ford Oud Wood clone. The corpus names the house outright and repeatedly: 'Woody Oud by Maison Alhambra', 'Woody oud by Alhambra', 'I really want to like Woody Oud by Maison', and 'tobacco touch ... (alhambra clone of tobacco vanille same line as woody oud)'. The corpus was built from 'tom ford oud wood dupe' searches, so a bare 'Woody Oud' here is always the Oud Wood clone.
notes: Some retailers list this exact bottle as 'Lattafa Woody Oud' (e.g. giftexpress, alrashad, fragflex) because Maison Alhambra is a sub-brand of Lattafa Perfumes Ind. LLC — the MAISON ALHAMBRA trademark is registered to Lattafa. This is a brand-labelling variance, NOT two different fragrances: the note pyramid is identical (agarwood top, sandalwood heart, amberwood/Cambodian oud base). One corpus comment ('Lataffa dropping banger after banger! I also picked up Asad & Woody Oud') reflects that same conflation. Prefer 'Maison Alhambra' as the brand, and carry 'Lattafa Woody Oud' as an alias so retailer-sourced strings still resolve. Cross-house risk is low: Arabian Oud ships a fragrance called 'Woody', not 'Woody Oud', and no 'Woody Oud' was found for Ard Al Zaafaran, Rasasi, Afnan or Armaf.

notes: CORRECTS A COMMITTED GUESS. scripts/seed_fragrances.py records Detour Noir as 'brand uncertain — probably Armaf, not verified'. It is not Armaf; it is Al Haramain, confirmed on Al Haramain's own storefronts. Deferring rather than guessing was the right call — the guess in the comment would have been wrong. One corpus comment reads 'Next to detour noir eco it's crap imo', where 'eco' is most likely a mistyped/abbreviated flanker reference; it is not identifiable and should not be resolved.

All seven corpus hits are inside Khamrah comparisons — 'Qahwa Khamrah is better', 'Khamrah Qahwa better than the original Khamrah imo', and one commenter explains it outright: 'Lattafa debuted a new version of their OG Khamrah scent called Qahwa, which is an arabic word for coffee'. notes: REAL CROSS-HOUSE AMBIGUITY, resolved only by this corpus. Fragrance World — a clone house that already appears in this corpus via Oud Wonder — ships its own fragrance simply called 'Qahwa'. Outside a Khamrah thread, a bare 'Qahwa' is genuinely undecidable between the two. This corpus is decidable because three of its 24 source videos are Khamrah reviews and every 'qahwa' hit is adjacent to the word 'khamrah'. Recommendation: resolve 'Qahwa' only when 'khamrah' co-occurs, and leave a bare standalone 'Qahwa' unresolved rather than defaulting. 'Qahwa' is also just the Arabic word for coffee, so it will appear in note descriptions too.
